name: document-generator
description: Professional document generator. Creates proposals, invoices, reports, presentations, contracts, and acts of completed works in PDF, DOCX, and PPTX formats. Supports multi-language documents with embedded fonts (Cyrillic, Latin, and more). First-use onboarding for style preferences, company profiles, and logo management. Converts between MD, DOCX, PDF, HTML, and PPTX.
